description.blurb: S/2004 S 46 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2004 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2004 S 46 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 20.5 million km in 1107.58 days. It has an inclination of 177.2° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.249.
